plugins.description: One guided session → first-grade Next.js website: dynamic scoping questions, three fast mockups, your approval, then the full build with sign-off checkpoints on a real-studio cadence — resumable mid-build, scoped by a sketch/standard/flagship dial, reviewable on your own phone via preview URLs. 80 interlocking skills + 3 model-routed subagents: taste constitution enforced at write time by hooks, award-canon study library (25 patterns from Awwwards SOTY-tier winners), client-asset intake, brand-mark identity, design-system-first pipeline, real quality gates, current-stack engineering.
